trails.name: Tbilsi Hiking trail
trails.why: Tbilisi Views - free video hiking tour around Tbilisi. Watch our guide hike aboe Georgian capital and listen to his explanations.

trails.name: Ushkhvanari - Latali
trails.why: This trail passes foothills of Svaneti and offers nice views of Ushba, Enguri valley and Svaneti range.

trails.name: Omalo–Artana near Omalo
trails.why: Little-known route connecting Tusheti highlands with Kakheti plains that combines little-known shepherd paths with the traverse of 3000m high ridge of the Greater Caucasus.

trails.name: Tetnuldi summit
trails.why: Tetnuldi is a prominent peak in the central part of the Greater Caucasus Mountain Range, located in the Svaneti region of Georgia.

trails.name: Narvani summit
trails.why: Narowani mountain in Georgia, on the side of the Ghats-Mayan mountains, on the administrative border of the Municipality of Kazakhstan and the Municipality of Dushet. It is located at the drainage of the Larowani River and the Stony Creek.

trails.name: Or-Tsveri summit
trails.why: Orvyr is a mountain in Georgia, on the Kakheti side, on the administrative border of the municipality of Telava and the municipality of Ahmet. It is located on the ridge of the river Stor and the Alazni watershed Diggverdi-Naceral.

trails.name: Natakhtashdudi pass
trails.why: Natatashdud is a canyon in Georgia, on the administrative border of the municipalities of Choroasu and Mesti, in the north-eastern part of the Upper Suvanna region. It is located on the hill of Agrisi.

trails.name: Ukantba Pass
trails.why: Atlatba is a gorge in Georgia, on the side of the Ghats Mountains, in the municipality of Dushet. It is located on the hill of Gudavar.

trails.name: Emlikli summit
trails.why: Emlikli is a volcanic mountain in Georgia, on the administrative border of the municipalities of Ninozhynde on the Sahel-Javakheti side and Dmanis on the Lower Georgian side.

trails.name: Tanie Lake
trails.why: Lake Tanies is a glacial circus-type lake in Georgia, in the municipality of Dushet. It is located on the northern slope of the main Caucasus in Tsitset-Khevsur, at an altitude of 2232 m above sea level. The surface area of the lake is 0.033 km2, maximum depth 7.6 m, water volume 123.

trails.name: Qelitsadi Lake
trails.why: Lake Kelisadi in the municipality of Kazacheg in Georgia. It is located above the lake, at the bottom of the Great Kaliska Northwest Basin, at an altitude of 3062 m above sea level. The surface area of the lake is 0.25 km2, maximum depth 14 m, water volume 2.12 million m3.

trails.name: Keli Lake
trails.why: Keli Lake is a volcanic-glacial lake in the Akhalgori Municipality, Mtskheta-Mtianeti region of Georgia.

trails.name: Ninoskhevi Waterfall
trails.why: The Ninoskhevi Waterfall, also known as Gurgeniani, stands 40m high. Situated 940m above sea level in Ninoskhevi Gorge, it's a prime feature of Lagodekhi National Park, marking it as one of Georgia's premier natural wonders.

trails.name: Aduyeda - Adzysh lake
trails.why: Adouedazhi, Adoueda-zhi, Adouedazhi is a glacial circus-type lake in Georgia, in the municipality of Ochamchiri. It is located on the northern slope of the Khodor ridge, at 2411 m above sea level. It has a glacial circus bottom.

trails.name: Gudamaqari Waterfall
trails.why: The Bursacherch in the Duchesne municipality, in the middle reaches of the Bursacherch River. 2170 m above sea level, 3 km northeast of Bursacherch village. The flat is formed by a strong flow of sand grains in the upper lipid deposits.

trails.name: Roki Pass
trails.why: A footpath to the pass: 3.1 km each way, +360 m, up to 2,980 m, from near Gudauri.

trails.name: Bethlemi Hut 3650
trails.why: Places for tents are almost available. Reservation for rooms inside is recommended via: info@gioland.ge

trails.name: Little Ritsa Lake
trails.why: Lake Smaller Ritsa, located in north-western Abkhazia, is a lake in the Caucasus Mountains, surrounded by mixed mountain forests and subalpine meadows.
